caption: Pro: a family base with arrows, a color for each relation and the Links legend.

caption: Free: Linked headings and blocks. Each link to a heading or block points to a small node on its note.

caption: Free: All headings. The image hangs from the Damage chapter, and Ideas links to Methods.
eval: (async () => { app.plugins.plugins['bases-link-graph'].pro.signOut(); await app.workspace.openLinkText('Bases Link Graph/Book graph.base#All headings', '', false); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1800)); let v = null; for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) { v = [...app.plugins.plugins['bases-link-graph'].views].filter((x) => x.containerEl.isConnected && x.containerEl.offsetParent !== null && x.graph && x.config.name === 'All headings').pop(); if (v && v.graph.nodes.length === 14) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); } if (!v || v.graph.nodes.length !== 14) throw new Error('Wrong All headings graph: ' + (v ? v.graph.nodes.length : 'none')); const g = v.graph; const ids = g.edges.filter((e) => e.kind === 'link').map((e) => g.nodes[e.source].id + ' > ' + g.nodes[e.target].id); if (!ids.includes('Bases Link Graph/Book/Ending Aging.md#Damage > Bases Link Graph/Book/cell-diagram.png')) throw new Error('No link from the Damage heading to the image'); return '14 nodes, 11 links'; })()
